moves.name: Attack
moves.effect: Deals 30 + X*10 damage, where X = turn number - 1.

pattern.description: Uses Attack every turn. Damage scales with turn number (30 + X*10, where X = turn number - 1). Ascension 2+: 40 + X*10 damage.

special_mechanics.description: Has Fading 5 + Shifting. Dies in 5 turns (6 on Ascension 17+). Upon taking attack damage, loses that much Strength until end of turn (no stacking).
special_mechanics.shifting: Loses Strength equal to damage taken until end of turn

threat_profile.notes: Extremely dangerous with scaling damage. Must kill quickly before damage becomes unmanageable. Shifting reduces Strength when attacked, making defense less effective. Achievement available for killing before Fading.

pattern.description: 50% Cut / 50% Spike. Cannot use Cut twice in a row. Can use Spike up to 6 times maximum per battle.

special_mechanics.description: Starts with 3 Thorns (4 on Ascension 2+, 7 on Ascension 17+). When attacked, deals Thorns damage to the attacker.

threat_profile.notes: Thorns damage punishes multi-hit attacks. Must kill carefully or avoid attacking. Spike increases Thorns further.

moves.name: Explode
moves.effect: Dies and deals 30 damage to the player.

pattern.description: Uses Slam twice, then uses Explode (dies and deals 30 damage).

special_mechanics.description: Has Combust power: Dies and deals 30 damage in 3 turns. Explosion no longer ignores Block.

threat_profile.notes: Low HP but will explode for 30 damage after 3 turns. Kill before explosion or have enough Block. Prioritize killing over other enemies.

moves.name: Repulse
moves.effect: Shuffles 2 Dazed into the draw pile.

pattern.description: 20% Bash / 80% Repulse. Cannot use Bash twice in a row.

threat_profile.notes: Mostly uses Repulse to flood deck with Dazed. Occasional Bash for damage. Not a priority target compared to Spiker or Exploder.

moves.name: Implant
moves.effect: Permanently adds a Parasite card to your deck.
moves.special: Can only be used once per combat

moves.name: Wither
moves.effect: Deals 10 damage, applies 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable.

pattern.description: Turn 1: Equal chance of Multi-Strike, Strong Strike, Flail, or Wither (25% each). After turn 1: 10% Implant, 30% Flail, 20% Wither, 30% Multi-Strike, 10% Strong Strike. Cannot use same move twice in a row. Intent always changes when Reactive is triggered.

special_mechanics.description: Has Malleable 3 + Reactive. Malleable: Gains X Block when attacked, increases by 1 each trigger, resets to X at turn start. Reactive: Changes intent when attacked.
special_mechanics.reactive: Changes intent upon receiving attack damage

threat_profile.notes: Very dangerous with high HP and multiple threatening moves. Implant permanently adds Parasite card to deck - kill quickly. Reactive makes it unpredictable when attacked. Malleable provides increasing Block.

moves.name: Laser
moves.effect: Deals 10 damage. Shuffles 1 Burn into draw pile and adds another to discard pile.

pattern.description: 60% Laser / 40% Claw. Neither move can be used three times in a row.

special_mechanics.description: At the end of its turn, gains X Strength (3 on normal, 5 on Ascension 17+). Can snowball quickly if not killed.

threat_profile.notes: Very dangerous with Strength Up buff. Gains 3 Strength every turn (5 on A17+). Must kill aggressively. Laser floods deck with Burn cards. Always attacks, so Weak is very effective.
